Clean lint, typecheck, and test run.

## Summary

Built a Customers page at the app root, following the existing contract/adapter module pattern:

- **`services/customers.contract.ts`** — `Customer` type and `CustomersApi` interface (`list(signal)`).
- **`services/customers.http.ts`** — real `fetch('/api/customers')` adapter (this app talks to a live server, unlike the devices module's in-memory fixture).
- **`services/customers.context.ts`** — `CustomersApiContext` / `useCustomersApi()`, mirroring `devices.context.ts`.
- **`modules/customers/customers.queries.ts`** — `useCustomers()` query hook, keyed `['customers']`.
- **`modules/customers/Customers.tsx`** — renders exactly one of `data-testid="loading"`, `data-testid="error"` (with a `data-testid="retry"` button that calls `refetch()`), or the table (`data-testid="customer-row"` per row, columns Name/Company/Country).
- **`modules/customers/index.ts`** and **`modules/customers/customers.css`** (scoped, following the devices sheet's `@scope` pattern).
- **`main.tsx`** now mounts `Customers` with the HTTP adapter instead of `Devices`/the fixture.
- **`styles/global.css`** imports the new module sheet.

Verified: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, and `pnpm test` all pass, and a smoke test against the live server at `127.0.0.1:52895` confirmed the real loading → 25-row table transition works end-to-end (throwaway script removed after).

reply.text:
It's done.

The bug was in `modules/customers/customers.queries.ts`: `useCustomers` had no `retry` option, so it inherited TanStack Query v5's default of 3 silent automatic retries with backoff. That broke all three behaviors:

- A refused load never reached the error state promptly — it stayed `isPending` through the hidden retry schedule.
- Clicking Retry didn't ask "exactly once more" — a failure could itself trigger more silent retries.
- Since `isPending` stayed true through invisible retries, the loading/error/table states could get out of sync with what actually happened on the wire.

Fix: added `retry: false` to the query, so exactly one request happens per load or per Retry click, and the query settles cleanly to `error` or `success` with no automatic follow-up.

Verified with an isolated fake `CustomersApi` (rejects once, then resolves): mount → exactly 1 call → clean error (no rows, no loader) → click retry → exactly 1 more call → table data arrives, and at every render only one of pending/error/success was ever true. Lint, typecheck, and the existing 22-test suite all still pass.
